goal: Borrow from devdotfast/whiteboard: Agent-Session commit trailer + 'why does this code exist' provenance query; file lenses + unplanned-decision pass in strata-diff-review

decisions.what: Trailer id comes from CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, no active-sessions file
decisions.why: Claude Code exports it to every Bash call; git hooks inherit it — exact attribution, human commits get nothing
decisions.evidence: env in this session + fresh claude -p run from /tmp; transcript filename matches

decisions.what: Skip trailer during rebase/cherry-pick; not on sequencer/
decisions.why: git runs prepare-commit-msg per replayed pick; sequencer/ also exists for multi-revert, which is new work
decisions.evidence: probe on git 2.48; test_p5 rebase/multi-pick/worktree/revert cases

decisions.what: Transcript offered only when its recorded cwd is under a worktree of this repo
decisions.why: project-dir slug cannot tell repo/sub from sibling repo-sub; forged trailers must not open other projects' transcripts (cso #3)
decisions.evidence: test_p5 'another project … not opened' with a -sibling cwd

decisions.what: Trailer wiring asked once at init/adopt/upgrade; decline stored in git config strata.trailer
decisions.why: trailer reveals agent-made commits in public history (cso #7); per-clone like the hook itself

decisions.what: File lenses kept in diff-review despite eng #10
decisions.why: owner asked for both; one paragraph of prompt

gotchas: git runs prepare-commit-msg for every rebase/cherry-pick pick — a trailer hook without a replay guard stamps the wrong session
git does not skip prepare-commit-msg under --no-verify: the wrapper must fail open or a missing script blocks every commit
a trailer makes an emptied editor message non-empty, so git commits it instead of aborting — check stripspace first
bash 3.2 + set -u: "${arr[@]}" on an empty array is 'unbound variable' and silently kills a piped while-loop — use ${arr[@]+"${arr[@]}"}
